description.zh: 以压暗遮罩放大展示图片或视频的媒体浮层，原页面暂时失去交互。内容居中呈现，常配左右切换、缩放与关闭；它是媒体专用的模态框，与通用对话框的区别在于主体是可观赏的视觉内容而非表单或文案。
description.en: A media overlay that enlarges an image or video over a dimmed, temporarily inert page. The media is centered and usually paired with prev/next, zoom and close. It is a modal specialised for viewing rather than for forms or copy — that is what separates it from a generic dialog.

use_when.zh: 需要查看图片细节、原图或成组照片
use_when.en: Inspecting image detail, full-size originals or photo sets

use_when.zh: 视频需要脱离页面布局专注播放
use_when.en: Video must play focused, free of the page layout

use_when.zh: 缩略图点击后预期放大预览
use_when.en: Thumbnails are expected to open a larger preview on click

avoid_when.zh: 内容是表单、说明或确认操作，用 modal
avoid_when.en: Content is a form, message or confirmation — use a modal

avoid_when.zh: 用户需要边看边操作底层页面，用 drawer 或 popover
avoid_when.en: Users must act on the page while looking — use a drawer or popover

avoid_when.zh: 媒体本身就是页面主体，直接用画廊页或视频播放页
avoid_when.en: Media is the page itself — use a gallery page or player page

note.zh: 单图全屏放大，可缩放或平移查看细节
note.en: One image full-screen with zoom or pan for detail

note.zh: 带左右箭头与计数，连续浏览组图
note.en: Arrows plus a counter to step through a set

note.zh: 浮层内播放视频，常自动播放并可全屏
note.en: Video plays inside the overlay, often autoplaying to full screen

task.zh: 打开灯箱浏览一组图片，用箭头切换并尝试缩放与关闭。
task.en: Open the lightbox over a photo set, step with arrows and try zoom and close.

checks.zh: 遮罩外点击或 Esc 可关闭，关闭后焦点回到缩略图
checks.en: Outside click or Esc closes; focus returns to the thumbnail

checks.zh: 图片加载失败或视频不可用时有替代说明
checks.en: Failed image or video states carry a replacement message

note.zh: modal 承载通用任务与文案，lightbox 专用于放大观赏媒体
note.en: Modal hosts generic tasks and copy; lightbox exists to view media enlarged

note.zh: carousel 在页面内轮播，lightbox 在压暗遮罩上全屏展示
note.en: Carousel rotates in-page; lightbox presents full-screen over a dimmed page

disambiguation.zh: Lightbox 是媒体专用的 Modal；Modal 是通用容器。灯箱打开的是「可以看的东西」，对话框打开的是「要你处理的事」。
disambiguation.en: A lightbox is a media-focused Modal; Modal is the generic container. A lightbox opens something to look at, a dialog opens something to deal with.

sources.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Full Screen Modal

notes.zh: 遮罩固定铺满并压暗底层，媒体用 object-fit: contain 居中，避免裁切。打开时锁定页面滚动、焦点困在浮层内；左右箭头与 Esc 均可键盘操作。切换用轻微淡入而非大幅位移，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Fix a dimmed backdrop across the viewport and center the media with object-fit: contain so nothing is cropped. Lock page scroll and trap focus while open; arrows and Esc work from the keyboard. Cross-fade between items rather than sliding hard, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个灯箱组件：点击缩略图在压暗遮罩上放大展示图片，支持左右切换与关闭。
basic.en: Create a lightbox that opens an enlarged image over a dimmed backdrop, with prev/next and close.

design.zh: 设计灯箱。要求：半透明压暗遮罩 + 居中媒体；底部计数与图注；左右切换箭头与右上角关闭；切换时轻微淡入；Esc 与点击遮罩可关闭；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a lightbox. Requirements: translucent dimmed backdrop with centered media; counter and caption at the bottom; prev/next arrows and a top-right close; gentle cross-fade when switching; close on Esc and backdrop click; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现灯箱：受控 index 与 open 状态；fixed inset-0 遮罩 + flex 居中的 figure；object-fit: contain 限制媒体尺寸；焦点困在浮层内，Esc 关闭并把焦点还给触发缩略图；图片 onError 显示占位说明。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind lightbox: controlled open and index state; fixed inset-0 backdrop with a flex-centered figure; object-fit: contain bounds the media; trap focus, close on Esc and restore focus to the trigger thumbnail; show a placeholder message on image error.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现灯箱（Lightbox）组件。
先检查现有浮层与 Design Token，优先复用遮罩、圆角与阴影变量。
用途：图片与视频的放大预览。
要求：
- 压暗遮罩 + 居中媒体，支持左右切换与关闭
- 焦点困在浮层内，关闭后焦点回到触发元素
- 图片加载失败有替代说明
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，支持键盘操作
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Lightbox component in the current project.
Inspect existing overlays and design tokens first and reuse backdrop, radius and shadow variables.
Usage: enlarged preview of images and video.
Requirements:
- Dimmed backdrop with centered media, prev/next and close
- Focus trapped in the overlay and restored to the trigger on close
- Replacement message when an image fails to load
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion and support keyboard operation
- No new dependencies
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
